title: LLM-guided robotic workflow finds a high-entropy Prussian blue urea-oxidation catalyst
summary: The workflow combined retrieval-grounded LLM candidate generation, theory-informed machine learning with applicability-domain screening and robotic high-throughput experiments, with human judgment in problem formulation and prioritization. Of 40 robotically tested compositions, Fe0.11Co0.35Ni0.33Mn0.16Zn0.05-PBA was best, reaching 1.371 V at 10 mA cm-2 for urea oxidation. Paired with a Pt/C cathode in a flow cell it reached 100 mA cm-2 at 1.352 V and ran for 300 h at 0.5 A cm-2.
